hero.title: One garment, designed for one person.
hero.body: Gwadlas is a bespoke house in Pretoria. Every piece starts on a blank page, often from shweshwe, umbhaco cloth or hand beadwork, and is drafted from your measurements and fitted on you.
hero.mobileBody: Made in Pretoria from your measurements. We ship worldwide.
